in_sanskrit.name: Sharujan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Prosperity and Happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharujan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharujan is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Sharu' meaning 'Goddess of Prosperity' and 'Jana' meaning 'People'. This name signifies the Goddess who brings prosperity and happiness to the masses.
